comment: The packet giving world (the owner's word of 2026-10-03, 09:46 Israel, 'a new emitter detector also needs to enter'; the mathematician's 224 (1), #1572 comment 5966081562, and 229, 5966424405; the advisor's seconds, 5966129376 with #1563 comment 5966129628, his derivation 5966387795 step 5 and his precisions 5966338551 step 5; two hands): the open board's giving as a packet along a drawn axis, read in the engine. On the Zeno atom's universe (examples/events/zeno/zeno_atom.json, T = 32,768, the light `pulse` the massless holder of the sign) an open board of `width` Nodes across on y and z and long on x, the one board of this lay the machine runs in minutes: the giver, the resonance world's atom standing in its upper part e, its transition g to e by `pulse` at the resonance [2, 3] and its giving e to g at the lifetime 48 with the window 48 (drawn per interval at the hazard 1 / 48 in the dark, the dark grain, its tick the jump line's), declares the packet's width 4, the one new number; the loader finds the board open (three axes above one Node) and holds the packet along x alone (the train of L slices from the body's Node fits neither y nor z), so the giver draws between +x and -x with its own generator. The lay: the one-line packet's root T / sin Omega = isqrt(T^2 den^2 div (den^2 - num^2)), twice S = T / (2 sin Omega), the plane's share per line (the mathematician's 242 section 1, #1572 comment 5967687794, and the advisor's second, 5967838095 section 1, two hands; the packet laid on the light record's first line alone), the envelope in the energy form (a_t = isqrt((R_t div tau) div w^2), R_(t+1) = R_t - w^2 a_t^2, the lay ending where a_t falls below 1), the wave number along x from the band's line with the transverse mode, cos k_x = 3 cos Omega - 2 cos(pi / (w + 1)), the level before a_t cos(k_x z + Omega) with the sine's root on the large number at the reference scale, isqrt(R^2 (den^2 - num^2)), one carried rounding, the carrier's phase exact (the floor root isqrt(den^2 - num^2) = 2 for 2.236 at [2, 3] had laid the before level at 0.943 a_t cos(k z + pi / 4), its mean square 8 / 9 of now's, the form short by 0.075 of the top's unit at the one-line root: Worker PACKET-DIAG's reading of the branch), the top-hat of w across; the body at the centre of x with L + 1 Nodes on either side. The detector: a region, the 4 x 4 slice across x at the derived reach from the body on the +x side, z_reach = (pi w / lambda) sqrt(S / L), its unit the record's own share per quantum read from the books, its window the run (one draw at the end). The share at the lay: sin Omega times the top-hat's excess 1.055 at its edges, 0.786 of the top's unit (the hands' derivation at T = 2^22), a GameBoard reading. The far reading: the light's level at the Node on the axis half way to the detector over the window of the passage after the giving's tick, cos Omega as SUM_t n_t (n_(t+1) + n_(t-1)) / (2 SUM_t n_t^2), a GameBoard reading labelled so. The blind in expectation.json, written by build_world.py from this design before any lay and never touched after; the reading in blind_and_reading.md, a miss a finding by name.
